headline: The View of Ye’s globe from the Sky for his Chicago shows 🌎🔥🙏 Via: @destuhhneeee 📸: @c
body:
The View of Ye’s globe from the Sky for his Chicago shows 🌎🔥🙏
Via: @destuhhneeee 
📸: @cambamscam 

Ye is back in Chicago for two nights at Soldier field
Thursday, September 3 and Friday, September 4. Hometown dates on the Bully tour. Doors at 6. Show at 8. Same stadium he used for the Donda listening events in 2021.
This is the first time he’s run official back-to-back stadium shows in Chicago since those Donda nights. South Shore to Soldier Field. Two sold-out dates in a 63,500-capacity building.
The run follows SoFi, Tampa, San Antonio, Europe, and New Orleans. Bully dropped in March. Chicago is the hometown stop.
